content:
The total must be divisible by both 11 and 13, so \(N=143\) since it is near 150.

Heavy oil: \(\frac{2}{11}\cdot 143=26\).

Light oil: \(143-26=117\).

Light oil with low sulfur: \(\frac{7}{13}\cdot 143=77\).

Since no heavy oil is low sulfur, low-sulfur total is 77.

High-sulfur oil: \(143-77=66\).

\boxed{66}
